newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: INTERVIEW-DFCC looks at corporate bonds.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-DFCC looks at corporate bonds.

text.p: DFCC Bank said on Wednesday it planned to become active in the local corporate bond market.
DFCC Bank assistant general manager for treasury Mangala Boyagoda told Reuters the local corporate debt market market was still tiny but likely to grow with demand for capital.
"We want to get into corporate medium-term and long-term debt," Boyagoda said in an interview.
"It (the local corporate debt market) is in a very embryonic stage, but we think there is much more scope to grow."
DFCC Bank chief executive Moksevi Prelis said Boyagoda had been appointed earlier this year to develop the bank's treasury activities.
